commands.name: slides
commands.description: Read, edit, convert and render presentations through the Aspose.Slides object model.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a presentation or selected slides.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output presentation.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path; defaults to a sibling using the target extension.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --slides
options.description: Slides to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every slide.

options.name: --to
options.description: Target presentation export format; 'slides render' writes slide images. Default: the --out extension's format. html5 writes .html or .htm.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a presentation: the engine's new presentation, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output presentation.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --template
options.description: A presentation to save as the new one. Default: the engine's new, empty presentation.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a presentation; nothing is written when one fails.

options.name: --encrypt
options.description: Password for the output presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --encrypt-env.

options.name: --encrypt-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the output presentation.

options.name: --encrypt-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the output presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Modify the input file itself atomically.

options.name: --ops
options.description: The operation document, {"ops": [...]}: a path to it, '-' to read it from stdin, or the document itself when the value starts with { (inline). At most 10000 operations; each is a set, add, delete, move or do. The kinds, rows, adds and actions: aspose-cli schema v2/slides/ops --operation directory; one of them in full: aspose-cli schema v2/slides/ops --operation <name>.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with '.out' inserted before the extension.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract the media a presentation embeds, byte for byte.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Safe extraction directory.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --slides
options.description: Slides to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every slide.

options.name: --what
options.description: What to extract: media, the pictures, audio and video the presentation embeds.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Read a presentation's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.

options.name: --at
options.description: The address of the object to read with everything below it, as read gives it in at. Default: the whole document.

options.name: --from
options.description: The address of the object the window starts at; a truncated read's window.next gives it.

options.name: --kind
options.description: List only objects of this kind, one the ops schema lists; repeat for several. Default: every kind.

options.name: --max-objects
options.description: The most objects one window lists. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render one or more slides for visual verification.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Raster resolution; refused for vector output such as svg. Range: 36-1200.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Check the input, the output and the options, then stop without running the command or writing any file. A dry run that succeeds does not guarantee that the command succeeds.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Local font directory searched in addition to the system fonts; repeat for more.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path. Default: the input path with the image extension. Several slides write <stem>.<slide>.<ext> beside it.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace the output file if it already exists.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --slides
options.description: Slides to process: 1-based numbers and ranges such as 1-3,7,9-, or all. Default: every slide; at most 20 per run.

options.name: --to
options.description: Image format. Default: the --out extension's format, else png.

options.name: --width
options.description: Exact raster width in pixels; replaces --dpi and is refused for vector output such as svg. Range: 64-20000.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search the text of a presentation's shapes, table cells, notes and chart titles; each hit names the object's address.

options.name: --case-sensitive
options.description: Match letter case exactly.

options.name: --max-hits
options.description: Maximum returned hits. Range: 1-10000.

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the presentation. Discouraged: visible in the process list; prefer --password-env.

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password for the presentation.

options.name: --password-stdin
options.description: Read the password for the presentation from the first line of stdin.

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Text to find, or a regular expression with --regex.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Treat the pattern as a culture-invariant regular expression with a one-second budget.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Matches to pass over before the returned hits; a truncated search's window.next sets it.

v2/slides/convert-result.description: Result of slides convert: the file a presentation or its selected slides were converted to.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written files: the one file the presentation was converted to, then any companion files its format needs, as HTML5's scripts.

slides.description: The --slides selection that was converted, normalized; omitted when every slide was.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the presentation and wrote the output, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

slidesConvertOutput.description: A file a presentation was converted to, or a companion file its format writes beside it.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v2/slides/create-result.description: Result of slides create: the new presentation and the template it was saved from, if any.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

slideCount.description: How many slides the created presentation holds.

inputs.description: The template the presentation was saved from; empty for the engine's new presentation.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the template and saved the presentation, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

v2/slides/edit-result.description: Result of slides edit: what each operation left, read from the saved presentation after it was opened again, and the inventory counts that changed.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

counts.description: The inventory counts that changed, each as [before, after]; the keys are those read reports in inventory.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded, saved and reopened the presentation, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

ops.description: What each operation left, in batch order: the object at its address in the saved file, or what its action returned; last, since it grows with the batch.

v2/slides/extract-result.description: Result of slides extract: the files written for the extracted media.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The written files, in presentation order: images, then audio, then video.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the presentation, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

slidesExtractedOutput.description: One extracted file and the media item it holds, by its index.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

index.description: The media item's 1-based position among all images, then audio, then video.

v2/slides/ops.title: Object table operations
v2/slides/ops.description: An edit's operations, applied in order to the document in memory; when one fails, nothing is written. Each kind's definition lists its addresses and rows, each add's and action's the engine call it makes.

address.description: An object's address: 'presentation' for the document itself, otherwise segments and keys from the document down, such as each kind's x-addresses shows. read gives every object's address.

set.description: Sets rows of the object at an address, in the order written; each row sets one engine member.
The address of the object whose rows are set.

props.description: The rows to set, by name, each in its kind's form; the definition of the addressed object's kind lists its rows.

add.description: Makes one engine call that creates an object, then sets rows of the new object.

delete.description: Deletes the object at an address.
The address of the object to delete.

move.description: Moves the object at an address to a position among its siblings.
The address of the object to move.

to.description: The position to move to, the engine's, from 0.

do.description: Makes one engine call on the whole document.

presentation.description: The presentation and its document properties.

layout.description: A layout slide of a master; a slide's layout row takes its SlideId.

image.description: A picture of the presentation's image collection.

notes.description: The notes slide of a slide.

shape.description: A shape of a slide, in a group or not.

type.description: The engine interface of the shape, such as IAutoShape or IPictureFrame.

line.fillType.description: ILineFillFormat.FillType. Only on IGeometryShape and IGraphicalObject.

line.color.description: ILineFillFormat.SolidFillColor.Color. Only on IGeometryShape and IGraphicalObject.

picture.description: IPictureFrame.PictureFormat.Picture.Image, as its position among the presentation's images. Only on IPictureFrame.

paragraph.description: A paragraph of a shape's, a table cell's or the notes' text.

run.description: A text run (portion) of a paragraph.

effective.color.description: IPortion.PortionFormat.GetEffective().FillFormat.SolidFillColor; null unless the effective FillType is Solid, for which alone the engine gives it.

cell.description: A cell of a table; a merged cell once, at its first row and column.

text.description: IChartTitle.TextFrameForOverriding.Text, null without one; set with AddTextFrameForOverriding(text).

textFormat.description: The character format of a chart's text, its title's, its legend's or an axis'.

axis.description: A chart's horizontal or vertical axis.

name.source.description: IChartSeries.Name.DataSourceType, and AsCells[0] when it is Worksheet.

point.description: A data point of a series.

value.source.description: IChartDataPoint.Value.DataSourceType, and AsCell when it is Worksheet.

xValue.source.description: IChartDataPoint.XValue.DataSourceType, and AsCell when it is Worksheet.

yValue.source.description: IChartDataPoint.YValue.DataSourceType, and AsCell when it is Worksheet.

bubbleSize.source.description: IChartDataPoint.BubbleSize.DataSourceType, and AsCell when it is Worksheet.

sizeValue.source.description: IChartDataPoint.SizeValue.DataSourceType, and AsCell when it is Worksheet.

value.source.description: IChartCategory.UseCell: Worksheet with AsCell, or Literal.

data.description: A cell of a chart's workbook.

add.section.description: Adds a section to a presentation: ISectionCollection.AddSection(string name, ISlide startedFromSlide)

startedFromSlide.description: The SlideId of the slide the section starts at.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new section to set after the call, as #/$defs/section lists them.

add.slide.description: Adds a slide to a presentation: ISlideCollection.InsertEmptySlide(int index, ILayoutSlide layout)

index.description: The new slide's position, the engine's, from 0; the slide count adds it at the end.

layout.description: The SlideId of the layout the new slide takes.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new slide to set after the call, as #/$defs/slide lists them.

add.notes.description: Adds a notes to a slide: INotesSlideManager.AddNotesSlide()

in.description: The address of the slide to add to.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new notes to set after the call, as #/$defs/notes lists them.

add.autoShape.description: Adds a shape to a slide: IShapeCollection.AddAutoShape(ShapeType shapeType, float x, float y, float width, float height)

in.description: The address of the slide to add to.

shapeType.description: The engine's ShapeType of the new shape.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new shape to set after the call, as #/$defs/shape lists them.

add.pictureFrame.description: Adds a shape to a slide: IImageCollection.AddImage(byte[] buffer), then IShapeCollection.AddPictureFrame(ShapeType shapeType, float x, float y, float width, float height, IPPImage image)

in.description: The address of the slide to add to.

image.description: The image file the picture shows.

shapeType.description: The engine's ShapeType of the frame, such as Rectangle.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new shape to set after the call, as #/$defs/shape lists them.

add.table.description: Adds a shape to a slide: IShapeCollection.AddTable(float x, float y, double[] columnWidths, double[] rowHeights)

in.description: The address of the slide to add to.

columnWidths.description: Each column's width, in points; their count is the table's column count.

rowHeights.description: Each row's height, in points; their count is the table's row count.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new shape to set after the call, as #/$defs/shape lists them.

add.chart.description: Adds a shape to a slide: IShapeCollection.AddChart(ChartType type, float x, float y, float width, float height), or AddChart(…, bool initWithSample) when initWithSample is given

in.description: The address of the slide to add to.

type.description: The engine's ChartType of the new chart.

initWithSample.description: Whether the chart starts with the engine's sample data; not given, the five-parameter call is made, which starts with it.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new shape to set after the call, as #/$defs/shape lists them.

add.paragraph.description: Adds a paragraph to a shape: IParagraphCollection.Insert(int index, IParagraph value) with new Paragraph(), in IAutoShape.TextFrame. Adds a paragraph to a notes: IParagraphCollection.Insert(int index, IParagraph value) with new Paragraph(), in INotesSlide.NotesTextFrame. Adds a paragraph to a cell: IParagraphCollection.Insert(int index, IParagraph value) with new Paragraph(), in ICell.TextFrame.

in.description: The address of the shape that is an IAutoShape, notes or cell to add to.

index.description: The new paragraph's position, the engine's, from 0.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new paragraph to set after the call, as #/$defs/paragraph lists them.

add.run.description: Adds a run to a paragraph: IPortionCollection.Insert(int index, IPortion value) with new Portion()

in.description: The address of the paragraph to add to.

index.description: The new run's position, the engine's, from 0.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new run to set after the call, as #/$defs/run lists them.

add.series.description: Adds a series to a shape: IChartSeriesCollection.Add(IChartDataCell cellWithSeriesName, ChartType type)

in.description: The address of the shape that is an IChart to add to.

cellWithSeriesName.description: The workbook cell that holds the series' name.

type.description: The engine's ChartType of the series.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new series to set after the call, as #/$defs/series lists them.

add.point.description: Adds a point to a series: One IChartDataPointCollection.AddDataPointFor…Series method, the one method names, with the workbook cells it takes

in.description: The address of the series to add to.

method.description: The method: AddDataPointForScatterSeries takes xValue and yValue; AddDataPointForBubbleSeries xValue, yValue and bubbleSize; AddDataPointForTreemapSeries and AddDataPointForSunburstSeries sizeValue; every other one value.

value.description: The cell of the point's value.

xValue.description: The cell of the point's x value.

yValue.description: The cell of the point's y value.

bubbleSize.description: The cell of the point's bubble size.

sizeValue.description: The cell of the point's size value.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new point to set after the call, as #/$defs/point lists them.

add.category.description: Adds a category to a shape: IChartCategoryCollection.Add(IChartDataCell chartDataCell)

in.description: The address of the shape that is an IChart to add to.

chartDataCell.description: The workbook cell that holds the category.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

props.description: Rows of the new category to set after the call, as #/$defs/category lists them.

do.copy_slide.description: ISlideCollection.InsertClone(int index, ISlide sourceSlide); returns the new slide's address.

sourceSlide.description: The SlideId of the slide to copy.

index.description: The copy's position, the engine's, from 0; the slide count adds it at the end.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.import_slide.description: ISlideCollection.AddClone(ISlide sourceSlide), or AddClone(ISlide sourceSlide, IMasterSlide destMaster, bool allowCloneMissingLayout) when master is given; the source slide is in another presentation. Returns the new slide's address.

file.description: The presentation the slide is copied from.

sourceSlide.description: The SlideId of the slide in that presentation.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the password of that presentation.

master.description: The SlideId of the master of this presentation the copy takes.

allowCloneMissingLayout.description: With master: whether the engine may copy a layout the master lacks.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.set_slide_size.description: ISlideSize.SetSize(float width, float height, SlideSizeScaleType scaleType), or SetSize(SlideSizeType type, SlideSizeScaleType scaleType) when type is given; returns nothing.

width.description: The slide width, in points; with height.

height.description: The slide height, in points; with width.

type.description: The engine's SlideSizeType; instead of width and height.

scaleType.description: How the engine scales the content: DoNotScale, EnsureFit or Maximize.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

do.replace_text.description: Presentation.ReplaceText(string oldText, string newText, ITextSearchOptions options, IFindResultCallback callback), with new TextSearchOptions() and the options given set on it; returns each match the callback reported: its text frame's address, the text found and its position.

newText.description: The text to put in its place.

args.description: The engine call's parameters, by name.

v2/slides/read-result.description: Result of slides read: a window of the presentation's objects in document order, each with every row of the table it has, and the whole presentation's inventory.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

inventory.description: How many objects of each kind of content the presentation holds: under read the kinds read lists, under notRead the others.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the presentation, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

objects.description: The objects of the window, in document order, each with its address, kind and rows; last, since it grows with the document.

v2/slides/render-result.description: Result of slides render: one image per rendered slide.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

outputs.description: The rendered slides in presentation order.

dpi.description: The raster resolution used; omitted for SVG and when --width set the size.

width.description: The exact raster width in pixels --width asked for; omitted otherwise.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the presentation and wrote the output, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

slidesSlideOutput.description: One slide image render wrote, and the slide it shows.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced file.

format.description: Format id of the produced file, e.g. png.

encrypted.description: true when the produced file is encrypted and opens only with its password; omitted when its format cannot carry a password.

v2/slides/search-result.description: Result of slides search: the matches in the text rows of the presentation's objects.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and the option values that continue it.

engineWarnings.description: The warnings Aspose.Slides reported while it loaded the presentation, as it reported them; omitted when there were none.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under; omitted when it ran licensed.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVALUATION_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

hits.description: The hits in document order: the object's address, the text row, and where the match is in it; last, since it grows with the document.
